# License decision — pending authorization

No option is selected. No LICENSE file or license metadata has been inserted. This note is a decision aid, not a permission grant or legal advice. The source project's distribution decision remains unresolved.

| Option | Practical effect | Obligations and tradeoffs |
|---|---|---|
| MIT | Broad use, modification and redistribution, including commercial use | Preserve copyright and permission notices; includes warranty/liability disclaimers. Short and simple; contains no express patent grant comparable to Apache-2.0. |
| Apache-2.0 | Broad permissive reuse with express contributor patent provisions | Include license, identify modified files and preserve applicable notices; carry relevant NOTICE attribution if supplied. More administration; patent grant has termination conditions and trademark rights are not generally granted. |
| Source-available terms | Publish readable source under specifically drafted permissions and restrictions | This is a category, not a single license. Commercial, redistribution or hosted-service limits depend on exact terms. Restrictive terms may prevent open-source classification and reduce reuse. Requires drafting and review. |

Owner decision needed: intended reuse and commercial permissions, redistribution/modification rights, patent concerns, brand/trademark treatment, contributor rights and any third-party obligations. Confirm authority to license all included text and templates, then authorize exact terms and required notices before publication. Do not infer licensing from public visibility or an MIT/FOSS exception in regulation.
